name: markdown-orchestration-nightly
description: Experimental fork of markdown-orchestration that trades per-chunk gate fan-out for batched review: build-only workers on the cheapest adequate model (opus only for risk-tagged chunks), quality and regression commands run inside the worker instead of as subagents, one combined reviewer per two finished chunks instead of three to five reviewers per chunk, and a cheap fixer for review fix-lists. Engages only on explicit request ("nightly" or /orchestrate-nightly). Requires markdown-orchestration for the repo-docs MCP and the grilling/domain-modeling companion skills.
